description: The estate's shared Renovate preset. Every enrolled repo consumes it as `github>lexijamesesq/dotty` from a two-line renovate.json, so dependency policy is declared once, here, and changing it changes every repo without touching any of them. Named default.json because that is the file Renovate resolves for a bare `github>owner/repo` reference.

packageRules.description: dotty's pre-commit hook channel. The calendar scheme is not semver, so it needs an explicit versioning regex or Renovate cannot order two releases. The year group is FOUR digits on purpose: it makes the floating `v1` tag unparseable under this scheme, so Renovate ignores it instead of ever writing a moving ref into a `rev:` — which pre-commit caches by its own text and would then never refresh again.

The estate's own reusable workflows float on `@v1` by design — release-on-merge moves that tag onto every release, which is what removed the per-release pin-bump PR in thirteen repos. Renovate must never bump it and must never pin it to a digest. Matched on depType `workflow`, the manager's own distinction between a reusable-workflow call and an action, rather than on a package name the docs do not specify. This also overrides helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests above, which would otherwise replace `@v1` with a commit sha and silently end the float.

Third-party actions, including majors. Every update type automerges on green: the operator's standard is that bot bumps merge themselves, and a major action bump held for a human is the stale-pin problem this whole piece exists to end. The mechanical floor (all-checks-passed, trusted-scan) is the gate that applies, and `margot` is satisfied by the declared-bot skip check.
